question: Which structural forms are prescribed for the northern and northeastern directions?
premises: The front-elephant form is assigned to the northern direction.
The all-auspicious form is likewise assigned to the northeastern direction.
The parallel construction extends the prescriptive pattern.
inference: The northern and northeastern directions receive distinct prescribed forms.
plain_english: The front-elephant form is prescribed in the north, and likewise the all-auspicious form in the northeast.
